sections_en.text: Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Technical specifications of the crane: maximum load 175 ton.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel Wahab El Darder, accepted by general director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Baset head sector of Aswan dam (1&2) hydraulic power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Raghib Hakem HPGC MPIS coordinator
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable safety category card.
Wear the personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet, ...etc
The crane must be out of service
Switch off the power supply

sections_en.text: Work to be Carried Out
Measure and record the insulation resistance for motors
Clean commutator, slip ring, brushes for motors
Check the ball bearings of the motors, grease / lubricate or replace if needed, (bearings and grease must be kept free of dirt)
Clean and inspect the main contacts of the contactors
Inspect and check the brake of the motors
Check all the tightens of the power and control circuits connections
Connect the power source to the crane and check all movements
